recipes.name: Lemon Yogurt Parfait
ingredients: ¼ cup unsweetened soy Greek-style yogurt
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the yogurt, cashew butter, maple syrup, lemon zest, and vanilla extract.
Crumble half the digestive biscuit into the bottom of a cup, top with half of the yogurt mixture, crumble the other half of the biscuit over that, then finish with the remaining yogurt.
Add the fruit and you're good to go!

page_recipe_notes: Storage The flavoured yogurt can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. The prepared parfait is best enjoyed immediately.
